source_title: Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 isolate Wuhan-Hu-1, complete genome
literature_notes: China CDC protocol released 2020-01-21 and reproduced in WHO in-house assay compilation, page 2, and Wei et al. 2020 Table 2 (10.46234/ccdcw2020.023). MN908947.3 is the actual mapping reference, not an asserted sole original design template. Exact mapped amplicon is 13342-13460 (119 nt); unchanged reference window 13242-13560 includes both primers and 100 nt on each flank. All three oligo sites match exactly. Original protocol has no accession-linked coordinate table, so paper-coordinate fields are NA.
